subject: maths
title: Statistics
description: Interpreting and presenting data in bar charts, pictograms and tables, including one-step and two-step questions.

objectives.statement: Interpret and present data using bar charts, pictograms and tables.
Solve one-step and two-step questions (for example, 'How many more?' and 'How many fewer?') using information presented in scaled bar charts and pictograms and tables.

questions.ask: In a pictogram, one apple symbol stands for 2 apples. What do 3 symbols stand for?
questions.claim: 3 apple symbols stand for {}.

questions.ask: In a pictogram, one star stands for 5 points. A team has 4 stars. How many points is that?
questions.claim: 4 star symbols worth 5 points each stand for {}.

questions.ask: In a pictogram, one circle stands for 10 books. How many circles are needed to show 35 books?
questions.claim: To show 35 books, where one circle stands for 10 books, you need {} circles.

questions.ask: In a pictogram, what does half a symbol usually stand for?
questions.claim: In a pictogram, half a symbol stands for {}.
questions.answer: half the value of a whole symbol
distractors: double the value of a whole symbol
the same as a whole symbol

questions.ask: In a pictogram, one sun symbol stands for 4 sunny days. What do 2 symbols stand for?
questions.claim: 2 sun symbols stand for {}.

questions.ask: What tells you how many each pictogram symbol is worth?
questions.claim: How many each pictogram symbol is worth is shown by {}.

questions.ask: In a pictogram, one square stands for 2 goals. Team A has 5 squares and Team B has 3 squares. How many more goals did Team A score?
questions.claim: With one square standing for 2 goals, Team A (5 squares) scored {} more goals than Team B (3 squares).

questions.ask: A bar chart shows favourite fruits: apples 10, bananas 14, grapes 7. Which fruit was the most popular?

questions.ask: A bar chart shows 20 children walk to school and 13 come by car. How many fewer come by car?

questions.ask: A table shows laps run: Monday 25, Tuesday 32. How many laps were run altogether?

questions.ask: A table shows Class A read 48 books and Class B read 29 books. How many fewer books did Class B read?

questions.ask: How is a group of five shown in a tally chart?

questions.answer: four lines with a fifth line across them

questions.claim: With Amy 24 and Ben 18 stickers, together they have {}.
